summary: Merge Robot and Python edge lists
description: Combine one small in-memory Robot edge list and one small in-memory Python edge list into a single list without duplicating identical edges. Do not re-run parsers.
scope: Pass two tiny in-memory lists, not file paths
Drop a second copy of an identical edge
acceptanceCriteria: merge_edges(robot_edges, python_edges) returns both unique edges and keeps a duplicated identical edge only once.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not compute fan-in or fan-out.
Do not re-run Robot or Python parsers.
